issues.detail: The Hebrew has two names: חֵזִיר (Hezir) and הַפִּצֵּץ (Happitsets). The Chinese renders them as 希宰爾 and 亞斯弗. The second name 亞斯弗 does not correspond to הַפִּצֵּץ; it appears to be a different name (possibly a transliteration of a different Hebrew name like אָסָף or similar). This is a name swap/error.
